_comment: Banner patterns onto a book, and no code at all: 26.1's shield-decoration recipe takes its `target`
from data rather than being hardcoded to shields, so pointing it at a book is the whole change. It
copies the banner's layers and base colour, and `createWithOriginalComponents` keeps the book's own
components -- its words, its Age, its dye -- which a plain shapeless recipe would discard.
Like the shield, it only patterns an *unpatterned* book. Nothing renders the pattern yet; this stores
it, and the 3D model is what will read it.
